name: Francisco Pizarro (Colombia)
description: Vertical tricolour of light blue, black and green, the black charged with the municipal arms of Francisco Pizarro.
history: Municipal flag of Francisco Pizarro, a municipality in the department of Nariño, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Francisco Pizarro arms — oval with a landscape, inscribed MUNICIPIO DE FRANCISCO PIZARRO
